_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Potato Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: A warm and comforting creamy potato soup, hearty and satisfying.

items.name: Garden Tomato & Cucumber Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Crisp romaine topped with fresh tomatoes and cucumbers from our garden, red onion, and Parmesan, served with house-made balsamic-Dijon vinaigrette.

items.name: Chicken & Cheddar Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Deli chicken, sharp cheddar, thinly sliced Granny Smith apple, and house-made creamy honey-Dijon on our house bread, pressed golden and crisp.
notes: Served with pickle and Featured Side

items.name: Fresh Fruit Cup
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: A refreshing mix of fresh pineapple, black seedless grapes, strawberries, Granny Smith apples, and Cara Cara oranges.

items.name: Carrot Cake Cheesecake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Creamy cheesecake and classic spiced carrot cake come together for a rich twist on two favorite desserts.
